### Chromatin potential for mTEC
pkm is the peak-cell matrix exported with ArchR.
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}

color_mTEC <- c("Transitional" = "#F7B4B4", 
                "Early mature" = "#CAB2D6", 
                "Mid mature" = "#a6bddb", 
                "Late mature" = "#ABDEB6", 
                "Immature" = "#fbdf72")

load(paste0(mTEC_root, 'RNA/mm_mTEC_DORC_500000.RData'))
load(paste0(mTEC_root, 'RNA/mm_mTEC_mat_smoothed_500000.RData'))
seu <- readRDS(paste0(mTEC_root, 'RNA/mm_mTEC_clean.rds'))
proj <- loadArchRProject(paste0(mTEC_root, 'ATAC/mm_mTEC_clean'))

pkm <- pkm[,colnames(seu)]
pkm$celltype <- factor(pkm$celltype, levels = c("Immature", "Transitional", "Early mature", "Mid mature", "Late mature"))
pkm$UMAP_1 <- seu@reductions$PHATE@cell.embeddings[,1]
pkm$UMAP_2 <- seu@reductions$PHATE@cell.embeddings[,2]
meta <- colData(pkm) %>% as.data.frame()
meta$cellnames <- rownames(meta)
meta$UMAP_1 <- seu@reductions$PHATE@cell.embeddings[,1]
meta$UMAP_2 <- seu@reductions$PHATE@cell.embeddings[,2]
umap <- meta %>% dplyr::select("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2") %>% as.matrix()
rownames(umap) <- rownames(meta)

groupDF <- meta %>% dplyr::select(celltype, cellnames)
trajectory <- c("Immature", "Transitional", "Early mature", "Mid mature", "Late mature")
traj <- get_trajectory(groupDF, group_by = "celltype", embedding = umap, trajectory = trajectory, preFilterQuantile = 1, postFilterQuantile = 1)

dorcMat_sm_norm <- t(apply(dorcMat_sm, 1, function(x) (x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))))
rnaMat_sm_norm <- t(apply(rnaMat_sm, 1, function(x) (x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))))
idx <- which(rowMeans(dorcMat_sm_norm - rnaMat_sm_norm) > 0)

norm_list <- filter_matrix(dmat = dorcMat_sm_norm[idx,rownames(traj)], rmat = rnaMat_sm_norm[idx,rownames(traj)], scale_max_abs_val = 10, gene_corr_cutoff = 0, scaling = 'minmax', ncore = 12)
ndmat <- norm_list[["ndmat"]]
nrmat <- norm_list[["nrmat"]]

embedding <- umap
embedding_arr_length_list <- calc_velocity(ndmat, nrmat, embedding[rownames(traj),], max_per_cell = 10, metric = 'cosine', cutoff = 0.95)
embedding_arr_length <- embedding_arr_length_list[[1]]
arr_length <- embedding_arr_length_list[[2]]

arrow_data <- smooth_arrows(embedding[rownames(traj),], embedding_arr_length, smooth_w = 30, min_count = 10, coef = 1.5, draw_all = FALSE)

data <- meta %>% dplyr::select(celltype, cellnames)
data$UMAP_1 <- umap[,1]
data$UMAP_2 <- umap[,2]
data_sub <- data %>% dplyr::filter(cellnames %in% rownames(traj))
data_sub$pseudotime <- traj[data_sub$cellnames,]$Trajectory

xrange <- max(data$UMAP_1) - min(data$UMAP_1)
yrange <- max(data$UMAP_2) - min(data$UMAP_2)

ggplot(data) +
  geom_point(aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = celltype), show.legend = TRUE, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = xrange/yrange) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_mTEC) +
  xlab("PHATE_1") +
  ylab("PHATE_2")


ggplot(data) +
  geom_point(aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2), show.legend = FALSE, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8, color = 'grey90') +
  geom_point(data = data_sub, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = pseudotime), show.legend = TRUE, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(ticks = FALSE, draw.ulim = FALSE, draw.llim = FALSE, 
                                theme = theme(legend.ticks = element_blank()))) +
  geom_segment(data = arrow_data, aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end), arrow = arrow(length = unit(2 , 'pt'), type = "closed"), lwd = 0.3, color = 'black') +
  coord_fixed(ratio = xrange/yrange) +
  scale_color_gradientn(colors = rev(choose_colorset("Spectral")),
                        limits = c(0, 100),
                        oob = scales::oob_squish) +
  xlab("PHATE_1") +
  ylab("PHATE_2")

```

### Checkpoints for mTEC
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
k <- 10
pkm  <- pkm[,colnames(seu)]
pkm$celltype <- factor(pkm$celltype, levels = c("Immature", "Transitional", "Early mature", "Mid mature", "Late mature"))
pkm$UMAP_1 <- seu@reductions$PHATE@cell.embeddings[,1]
pkm$UMAP_2 <- seu@reductions$PHATE@cell.embeddings[,2]
meta <- colData(pkm) %>% as.data.frame()
meta$cellnames <- rownames(meta)
meta$UMAP_1 <- seu@reductions$PHATE@cell.embeddings[,1]
meta$UMAP_2 <- seu@reductions$PHATE@cell.embeddings[,2]
umap <- meta %>% dplyr::select("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2") %>% as.matrix()
rownames(umap) <- rownames(meta)

groupDF <- meta %>% dplyr::select(celltype, cellnames)
trajectory <- c("Immature", "Transitional", "Early mature", "Mid mature", "Late mature")
traj <- get_trajectory(groupDF, group_by = "celltype", embedding = umap, trajectory = trajectory, preFilterQuantile = 1, postFilterQuantile = 1)

dorcMat_sm_norm <- t(apply(dorcMat_sm, 1, function(x) (x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))))
rnaMat_sm_norm <- t(apply(rnaMat_sm, 1, function(x) (x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))))
idx <- which(rowMeans(dorcMat_sm_norm - rnaMat_sm_norm) > 0)

norm_list <- filter_matrix(dmat = dorcMat_sm_norm[idx,rownames(traj)], rmat = rnaMat_sm_norm[idx,rownames(traj)], scale_max_abs_val = 10, gene_corr_cutoff = 0, scaling = 'minmax', ncore = 12)
ndmat <- norm_list[["ndmat"]]
nrmat <- norm_list[["nrmat"]]

embedding <- umap

# calculate dT
df_time <- calc_neigh(traj, ndmat, nrmat, embedding[rownames(traj),], max_per_cell = k, metric = 'cosine', cutoff = 0.95)
df_time_corrected <- df_time %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(diff = new_time - old_time)
df_time_corrected$y <- df_time_corrected$diff
df_time_corrected$x <- df_time_corrected$old_time

# spline fitting
library(splines)
knots <- 1:50 * 2 -1
fit <- lm(y ~ ns(x, knots = knots, Boundary.knots = c(0, 100)), data = df_time_corrected)
predict_y <- function(x_new) {
  predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x_new))
}

# calc roots
roots <- list()
for (i in 0:99) {
  f <- function(x) predict_y(x)
  root <- tryCatch({
    # if(predict_y(i + 1) - predict_y(i) < 1){return(NA)}
    uniroot(f, interval = c(i, i + 1))$root
  },
  error = function(e) NA 
  )
  roots[[i + 1]] <- root
}
valid_roots <- unlist(roots[!is.na(roots)])
spline_deriv <- function(x) {
  h <- 1e-5
  (predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x + h)) - 
      predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x - h))) / (2 * h)
}

derivatives_at_roots <- sapply(valid_roots, spline_deriv)
valid_roots <- valid_roots[derivatives_at_roots > 0]

find_extrema <- function(a, b, n = 100) {
  x_grid <- seq(a, b, length.out = n)  
  deriv_values <- sapply(x_grid, spline_deriv)
  extrema <- c()
  for (i in 2:(n - 1)) {
    if (deriv_values[i] * deriv_values[i + 1] < 0) { 
      root <- uniroot(
        spline_deriv,
        interval = c(x_grid[i], x_grid[i + 1]),
        tol = 1e-6
      )$root
      extrema <- c(extrema, root)
    }
  }
  return(extrema)
}

extrema_x <- find_extrema(0, 100)
extreme_filter <- sapply(valid_roots, function(x){
  x_start <- tail(extrema_x[which(extrema_x < x)], 1)
  x_end <- head(extrema_x[which(extrema_x > x)], 1)
  predict_y(x_end) - predict_y(x_start) > 2
})
valid_roots <- valid_roots[extreme_filter]
print(valid_roots)

df_time_corrected$tech = "DORC"
df_time_corrected$diff_pred <- predict_y(df_time_corrected$old_time)


ggplot(df_time_corrected, aes(x = old_time, color = tech)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = diff_pred), size = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_tech) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = valid_roots, linetype = 2, color = "#4d004b") +
  xlim(0, 100) +
  coord_fixed(100 / (max(df_time_corrected$diff_pred) - min(df_time_corrected$diff_pred))) +
  ggtitle(paste0("B-spline, k = ", k))


```

### Chromatin potential for mouse skin
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}

color_celltype <- c("Hair Shaft-cuticle.cortex" = "#FF7F00",
                    "IRS" = "#fe9376",
                    "Medulla" = "#7BAFDE",
                    "TAC-1" = "#FFE060",
                    "TAC-2" = "#B2DF8A")

load(paste0(mmskin_root, "RNA/mmskin_mat_smoothed.RData"))
meta <- read_tsv(paste0(mmskin_root, "scarlink/pred_meta.tsv"))
meta$cellnames <- paste0('mmskin#', meta$cell_name_atac)
umap <- read.delim(paste0(mmskin_root, "scarlink/mmskin_umap.tsv"), header = FALSE)
colnames(umap) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
rownames(umap) <- meta$cellnames
umap <- as.matrix(umap)
meta$UMAP_1 <- umap[,1]
meta$UMAP_2 <- umap[,2]
meta$celltype[meta$UMAP_2 > -10] <- NA

groupDF <- meta %>% dplyr::select(celltype, cellnames) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cellnames")
trajectory <- c("TAC-1", "TAC-2", "Hair Shaft-cuticle.cortex")
traj <- get_trajectory(groupDF, group_by = "celltype", embedding = umap, trajectory = trajectory)

# dorcMat_sm_norm <- t(apply(dorcMat_sm, 1, function(x) (x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))))
# rnaMat_sm_norm <- t(apply(rnaMat_sm, 1, function(x) (x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))))
idx <- which(rowMeans(dorcMat_sm_norm - rnaMat_sm_norm) > 0)

norm_list <- filter_matrix(dmat = dorcMat_sm_norm[idx,rownames(traj)], rmat = rnaMat_sm_norm[idx,rownames(traj)], scale_max_abs_val = 10, gene_corr_cutoff = 0, scaling = 'minmax', ncore = 12)
ndmat <- norm_list[["ndmat"]]
nrmat <- norm_list[["nrmat"]]

embedding <- umap
embedding_arr_length_list <- calc_velocity(ndmat, nrmat, embedding[rownames(traj),], max_per_cell = 10, metric = 'cosine', cutoff = 0.95)
embedding_arr_length <- embedding_arr_length_list[[1]]
arr_length <- embedding_arr_length_list[[2]]

arrow_data <- smooth_arrows(embedding[rownames(traj),], embedding_arr_length, smooth_w = 30, min_count = 5, coef = 1.5, draw_all = FALSE)

data <- meta %>% dplyr::select(celltype, Clusters, cellnames)
data$UMAP_1 <- umap[,1]
data$UMAP_2 <- umap[,2]
data_sub <- data %>% dplyr::filter(cellnames %in% rownames(traj))
data_sub$pseudotime <- traj[data_sub$cellnames,]$Trajectory

xrange <- max(data$UMAP_1) - min(data$UMAP_1)
yrange <- max(data$UMAP_2) - min(data$UMAP_2)

  
ggplot(data) +
  geom_point(aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2), show.legend = FALSE, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8, color = 'grey90') +
  geom_point(data = data_sub, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = celltype), show.legend = TRUE, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = xrange/yrange) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_celltype)

ggplot(data) +
    geom_point(aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2), show.legend = FALSE, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8, color = 'grey90') +
    geom_point(data = data_sub, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = pseudotime), show.legend = TRUE, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    theme_classic() +
    guides(color = guide_colorbar(ticks = FALSE, draw.ulim = FALSE, draw.llim = FALSE, 
                                 theme = theme(legend.ticks = element_blank()))) +
    geom_segment(data = arrow_data, aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end), arrow = arrow(length = unit(2 , 'pt'), type = "closed"), lwd = 0.3, color = 'black') +
    coord_fixed(ratio = xrange/yrange) +
    scale_color_gradientn(colors = rev(choose_colorset("Spectral")),
                          limits = c(0, 100),
                          oob = scales::oob_squish)
```

### Checkpoints for mouse skin
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
k = 10
load(paste0(mmskin_root, "RNA/mmskin_mat_smoothed.RData"))
meta <- read_tsv(paste0(mmskin_root, "scarlink/pred_meta.tsv"))
meta$cellnames <- paste0('mmskin#', meta$cell_name_atac)
umap <- read.delim(paste0(mmskin_root, "scarlink/mmskin_umap.tsv"), header = FALSE)
colnames(umap) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
rownames(umap) <- meta$cellnames
umap <- as.matrix(umap)
meta$UMAP_1 <- umap[,1]
meta$UMAP_2 <- umap[,2]
meta$celltype[meta$UMAP_2 > -10] <- NA

groupDF <- meta %>% dplyr::select(celltype, cellnames) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cellnames")
trajectory <- c("TAC-1", "TAC-2", "Hair Shaft-cuticle.cortex")
traj <- get_trajectory(groupDF, group_by = "celltype", embedding = umap, trajectory = trajectory)

# rnaMat_sm_norm <- t(apply(rnaMat_sm, 1, function(x) (x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))))
idx <- which(rowMeans(dorcMat_sm_norm - rnaMat_sm_norm) > 0)

norm_list <- filter_matrix(dmat = dorcMat_sm_norm[idx,rownames(traj)], rmat = rnaMat_sm_norm[idx,rownames(traj)], scale_max_abs_val = 10, gene_corr_cutoff = 0, scaling = 'minmax', ncore = 12)
ndmat <- norm_list[["ndmat"]]
nrmat <- norm_list[["nrmat"]]

embedding <- umap

df_time <- calc_neigh(traj, ndmat, nrmat, embedding[rownames(traj),], max_per_cell = k, metric = 'cosine', cutoff = 0.95)
df_time_corrected <- df_time %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(diff = new_time - old_time)
df_time_corrected$y <- df_time_corrected$diff
df_time_corrected$x <- df_time_corrected$old_time

# spline fitting
library(splines)
knots <- 1:50 * 2 -1
fit <- lm(y ~ ns(x, knots = knots, Boundary.knots = c(0, 100)), data = df_time_corrected)
predict_y <- function(x_new) {
  predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x_new))
}

# calc roots
roots <- list()
for (i in 0:99) {
  f <- function(x) predict_y(x)
  root <- tryCatch({
    # if(predict_y(i + 1) - predict_y(i) < 1){return(NA)}
    uniroot(f, interval = c(i, i + 1))$root
  },
  error = function(e) NA 
  )
  roots[[i + 1]] <- root
}
valid_roots <- unlist(roots[!is.na(roots)])
spline_deriv <- function(x) {
  h <- 1e-5
  (predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x + h)) - 
      predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x - h))) / (2 * h)
}

derivatives_at_roots <- sapply(valid_roots, spline_deriv)
valid_roots <- valid_roots[derivatives_at_roots > 0]

find_extrema <- function(a, b, n = 100) {
  x_grid <- seq(a, b, length.out = n)  
  deriv_values <- sapply(x_grid, spline_deriv)
  extrema <- c()
  for (i in 2:(n - 1)) {
    if (deriv_values[i] * deriv_values[i + 1] < 0) { 
      root <- uniroot(
        spline_deriv,
        interval = c(x_grid[i], x_grid[i + 1]),
        tol = 1e-6
      )$root
      extrema <- c(extrema, root)
    }
  }
  return(extrema)
}

extrema_x <- find_extrema(0, 100)
extreme_filter <- sapply(valid_roots, function(x){
  x_start <- tail(extrema_x[which(extrema_x < x)], 1)
  if(length(x_start) == 0) x_start <- 0
  x_end <- head(extrema_x[which(extrema_x > x)], 1)
  if(length(x_end) == 0) x_end <- 100
  predict_y(x_end) - predict_y(x_start) > 2
})
valid_roots <- valid_roots[extreme_filter]
print(valid_roots)

df_time_corrected$tech = "DORC"
df_time_corrected$diff_pred <- predict_y(df_time_corrected$old_time)

        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +

  geom_vline(xintercept = valid_roots, linetype = 2, color = "#4d004b") +

  coord_fixed(100 / (max(df_time_corrected$diff_pred) - min(df_time_corrected$diff_pred))) +
  ggtitle(paste0("B-spline, k = ", k))
  
  
```

### Chromatin potential for pituitary
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}

color_celltype <- c("Corticotropes" = "#F7962E",
                    "Gonadotropes" = "#FFB6C1",
                    "Lactotropes" = "#7BAFDE",
                    "PSC" = "#E4EBB6",
                    "Pregonadotropes" = "#B2DF8A",
                    "Somatotropes" = "#9398D2FF",
                    "Thyrotropes" = "#FFE060")

load(paste0(pit_root, 'RNA/pituitary_mat_smoothed_500000.RData'))
load(paste0(pit_root, 'RNA/pituitary_DORC_500000.RData'))
seu <- readRDS(paste0(pit_root, 'RNA/pituitary.rds'))
proj <- loadArchRProject(paste0(pit_root, 'ATAC/pituitary'))

pkm <- pkm[,colnames(seu)]
pkm$celltype <- factor(pkm$celltype, levels = c("PSC", "Pregonadotropes", "Gonadotropes", "Thyrotropes", "Lactotropes", "Somatotropes", "Corticotropes"))
meta <- colData(pkm) %>% as.data.frame()
meta$cellnames <- rownames(meta)
meta$UMAP_1 <- seu@reductions$ForceAtlas@cell.embeddings[,1]
meta$UMAP_2 <- seu@reductions$ForceAtlas@cell.embeddings[,2]
umap <- meta %>% dplyr::select("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2") %>% as.matrix()
rownames(umap) <- rownames(meta)

groupDF <- meta %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::select(celltype, cellnames) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cellnames")
trajectory <- c("PSC", "Pregonadotropes", "Gonadotropes")
traj <- get_trajectory(groupDF, group_by = "celltype", embedding = umap, trajectory = trajectory, preFilterQuantile = 1, postFilterQuantile = 1)

idx <- apply(dorcMat_sm[,rownames(traj)], 1, sd) > 0 & apply(rnaMat_sm[,rownames(traj)], 1, sd) > 0
dorcMat_sm <- dorcMat_sm[idx,]
rnaMat_sm <- rnaMat_sm[idx,]

dorcMat_sm_norm <- t(apply(dorcMat_sm, 1, function(x) (x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))))
rnaMat_sm_norm <- t(apply(rnaMat_sm, 1, function(x) (x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))))
idx <- which(rowMeans(dorcMat_sm_norm - rnaMat_sm_norm) > 0)

norm_list <- filter_matrix(dmat = dorcMat_sm[idx,rownames(traj)], rmat = rnaMat_sm[idx,rownames(traj)], scale_max_abs_val = 10, gene_corr_cutoff = 0, scaling = 'minmax', ncore = 12)
ndmat <- norm_list[["ndmat"]]
nrmat <- norm_list[["nrmat"]]

embedding <- umap
embedding_arr_length_list <- calc_velocity(ndmat, nrmat, embedding[rownames(traj),], max_per_cell = 10, metric = 'cosine', cutoff = 0.95)
embedding_arr_length <- embedding_arr_length_list[[1]]
arr_length <- embedding_arr_length_list[[2]]

arrow_data <- smooth_arrows(embedding[rownames(traj),], embedding_arr_length, smooth_w = 70, min_count = 2, coef = 1.5, draw_all = FALSE)

data <- meta %>% dplyr::select(celltype, cellnames)
data$UMAP_1 <- umap[,1]
data$UMAP_2 <- umap[,2]
data_sub <- data %>% dplyr::filter(cellnames %in% rownames(traj))
data_sub$pseudotime <- traj[data_sub$cellnames,]$Trajectory

xrange <- max(data$UMAP_1) - min(data$UMAP_1)
yrange <- max(data$UMAP_2) - min(data$UMAP_2)
  
ggplot(data) +
  geom_point(aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2), show.legend = FALSE, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8, color = 'grey90') +
  geom_point(data = data_sub, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = celltype), show.legend = TRUE, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 5))) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = xrange/yrange) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_celltype)

ggplot(data) +
  geom_point(aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2), show.legend = FALSE, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8, color = 'grey90') +
  geom_point(data = data_sub, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, color = pseudotime), show.legend = TRUE, size = 0.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  guides(color = guide_colorbar(ticks = FALSE, draw.ulim = FALSE, draw.llim = FALSE, 
                                theme = theme(legend.ticks = element_blank()))) +
  geom_segment(data = arrow_data, aes(x = x_start, y = y_start, xend = x_end, yend = y_end), arrow = arrow(length = unit(1.5 , 'pt'), type = "closed"), lwd = 0.3, color = 'black') +
  coord_fixed(ratio = xrange/yrange) +

                        limits = c(0, 100),
```

### Checkpoints for pituitary
```{r eval=TRUE, include=TRUE, echo=TRUE, results='hold', collapse=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=5}
k = 10

pkm$celltype <- factor(pkm$celltype, levels = c("PSC", "Pregonadotropes", "Gonadotropes", "Thyrotropes", "Lactotropes", "Somatotropes", "Corticotropes"))
meta <- colData(pkm) %>% as.data.frame()
meta$cellnames <- rownames(meta)
meta$UMAP_1 <- seu@reductions$ForceAtlas@cell.embeddings[,1]
meta$UMAP_2 <- seu@reductions$ForceAtlas@cell.embeddings[,2]
umap <- meta %>% dplyr::select("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2") %>% as.matrix()
rownames(umap) <- rownames(meta)

groupDF <- meta %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% 
  dplyr::select(celltype, cellnames) %>%
  column_to_rownames("cellnames")
trajectory <- c("PSC", "Pregonadotropes", "Gonadotropes")
traj <- get_trajectory(groupDF, group_by = "celltype", embedding = umap, trajectory = trajectory, preFilterQuantile = 1, postFilterQuantile = 1)

idx <- apply(dorcMat_sm[,rownames(traj)], 1, sd) > 0 & apply(rnaMat_sm[,rownames(traj)], 1, sd) > 0
dorcMat_sm <- dorcMat_sm[idx,]
rnaMat_sm <- rnaMat_sm[idx,]

dorcMat_sm_norm <- t(apply(dorcMat_sm, 1, function(x) (x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))))
rnaMat_sm_norm <- t(apply(rnaMat_sm, 1, function(x) (x-min(x))/(max(x)-min(x))))
idx <- which(rowMeans(dorcMat_sm_norm - rnaMat_sm_norm) > 0)

norm_list <- filter_matrix(dmat = dorcMat_sm[idx,rownames(traj)], rmat = rnaMat_sm[idx,rownames(traj)], scale_max_abs_val = 10, gene_corr_cutoff = 0, scaling = 'minmax', ncore = 12)
ndmat <- norm_list[["ndmat"]]
nrmat <- norm_list[["nrmat"]]

embedding <- umap

df_time <- calc_neigh(traj, ndmat, nrmat, embedding[rownames(traj),], max_per_cell = k, metric = 'cosine', cutoff = 0.95)
df_time_corrected <- df_time %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(diff = new_time - old_time)
df_time_corrected$y <- df_time_corrected$diff
df_time_corrected$x <- df_time_corrected$old_time

# spline fitting
library(splines)
knots <- 1:50 * 2 -1
fit <- lm(y ~ ns(x, knots = knots, Boundary.knots = c(0, 100)), data = df_time_corrected)
predict_y <- function(x_new) {
  predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x_new))
}

# calc roots
roots <- list()
for (i in 0:99) {
  f <- function(x) predict_y(x)
  root <- tryCatch({
    # if(predict_y(i + 1) - predict_y(i) < 1){return(NA)}
    uniroot(f, interval = c(i, i + 1))$root
  },
  error = function(e) NA 
  )
  roots[[i + 1]] <- root
}
valid_roots <- unlist(roots[!is.na(roots)])
spline_deriv <- function(x) {
  h <- 1e-5
  (predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x + h)) - 
      predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(x = x - h))) / (2 * h)
}

derivatives_at_roots <- sapply(valid_roots, spline_deriv)
valid_roots <- valid_roots[derivatives_at_roots > 0]

find_extrema <- function(a, b, n = 100) {
  x_grid <- seq(a, b, length.out = n)  
  deriv_values <- sapply(x_grid, spline_deriv)
  extrema <- c()
  for (i in 2:(n - 1)) {
    if (deriv_values[i] * deriv_values[i + 1] < 0) { 
      root <- uniroot(
        spline_deriv,
        interval = c(x_grid[i], x_grid[i + 1]),
        tol = 1e-6
      )$root
      extrema <- c(extrema, root)
    }
  }
  return(extrema)
}

extrema_x <- find_extrema(0, 100)
extreme_filter <- sapply(valid_roots, function(x){
  x_start <- tail(extrema_x[which(extrema_x < x)], 1)
  x_end <- head(extrema_x[which(extrema_x > x)], 1)
  predict_y(x_end) - predict_y(x_start) > 2
})
valid_roots <- valid_roots[extreme_filter]
print(valid_roots)

df_time_corrected$tech = "DORC"
df_time_corrected$diff_pred <- predict_y(df_time_corrected$old_time)

ggplot(df_time_corrected, aes(x = old_time, color = tech)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = diff_pred), size = 1) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8, color = "black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_tech) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = valid_roots, linetype = 2, color = "#4d004b") +
  xlim(0, 100) +
  coord_fixed(100 / (max(df_time_corrected$diff_pred) - min(df_time_corrected$diff_pred))) +
  ggtitle(paste0("B-spline, k = ", k))
```
